name: np_wipers
character: Windscreen wipers on a wet screen: a swish of rubber on glass every half cycle and a soft thump at each turn, 70 cycles a minute, slowing in the slow motion.
note: One sweep every 0.43 s (70 double strokes a minute); the interval grows up to four times in the slow motion. ESTIMATE: the swish band, the thump and the levels are starting values; the rate is from FMVSS 104 and service data in the research note
